meta.name: NGIS Admin — Shikhaor-clean Orange DNA
meta.description: Clean white ERP dashboard skin: measured from Shikhaor admin dashboard reference; applied to NGIS admin portal via body[data-role=admin] token overrides.

primary.role: brand fill: active CTAs, selected states, focus accents

secondary.role: dark ink fill for contrast segments (donut absent slice, chips)

accent.role: emphasis: export/primary buttons, view-all links, alert icons

neutral.usage: Workspace #FBFBFB; cards #FFFFFF; borders/dividers #ECE7E2; secondary text #757371; body ink #1D1D1B on light surfaces (measured text role)

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant; orange reserved for action emphasis; AA-safe deep orange #C24E1F for small orange text on white

typography.font_style_notes: Humanist geometric sans; reference uses 600-700 weights but NGIS project rule caps all weights at 500 — hierarchy carried by size, color and spacing instead.

layout.columns: KPI row x4; charts row 5/7 split; bottom row 4/4/4

elevation.depth_cues: color intensity + hairline borders, not shadows

motion.philosophy: minimal functional — no scaling/lift hover per NGIS interaction rules

components.button_style: solid orange #F77442 white-label radius 10-12px; ghost = white + 1px #ECE7E2 border
components.input_style: white, 1px border, radius 10px, orange focus ring 2px rgba(247,116,66,.25)
components.card_style: white surface, 1px #ECE7E2, radius 14-16px, padding 16-20px, near-flat shadow
components.navigation_pattern: white sidebar, group overlines in #9D9A97, active item = #FDEBDF pill with #C24E1F label + orange left indicator
components.list_style: icon-chip + two-line item + right pill action, hairline dividers
components.component_notes: KPI card = icon chip left, label+value stacked, sparkline right, delta caption bottom-left green +x% / 'From Last Months'.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: paper-and-ink ledger with a single warm signal color

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous inside cards, tight between list rows
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: top-heavy: KPI row carries the hierarchy
visual_language.focal_strategy: single accent color guides eye from greeting to KPIs to actions
visual_language.contrast_level: medium-high text contrast, low surface contrast

imagery.image_shape: circle for avatars, rounded-rect for chips

interaction_feel.feedback_style: state swap (pill background tint), no motion excess
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: neutral per NGIS card-color-neutrality rule: no hover tint changes beyond border/focus

overview.fallback_strategy: static SVG charts render without JS

visual_effects.composite_notes: Charts are static inline SVG (polyline sparklines, path line chart, stroke-dasharray donut). No canvas/WebGL/scroll effects in reference — it is a flat, print-calm dashboard.
